props.description: Tres ideas que este prototipo pone a prueba.

items.title: Datos, no código
items.description: Una página nueva es un documento del Hub, sin commit ni despliegue.

items.title: Validado en el borde
items.description: Un bloque que no cumple su esquema se omite y se cuenta en Server-Timing.

items.title: Temas por host
items.description: El mismo documento se viste distinto según el dominio que lo sirve.

items.q: ¿Hay que desplegar para publicar una página?
items.a: No. El site lee el documento publicado del Hub y lo guarda en caché hasta que el Hub la purga por tag.
Se sirve la última copia buena con la cabecera x-saastro-stale. Sin copia, un 503 con Retry-After.

title: Pages written
as data
props.subtitle: This page is not in the repository: it is a document. The site validates every block against its schema and renders it at the edge.

props.title: What changes
props.description: Three ideas this prototype puts to the test.

items.title: Data, not code
items.description: A new page is a Hub document: no commit, no deploy.

items.title: Validated at the edge
items.description: A block that fails its schema is skipped and counted in Server-Timing.

items.title: Themes per host
items.description: The same document dresses differently depending on the domain serving it.

items.q: Do I need to deploy to publish a page?
items.a: No. The site reads the published document from the Hub and caches it until the Hub purges it by tag.

items.q: What if the Hub is down?
items.a: The last good copy is served with the x-saastro-stale header. With no copy, a 503 with Retry-After.
